rows.label: qst501804_msg0001
rows.name: You're Shiki-san, right?

rows.label: qst501804_msg0002
rows.name:
That's right. Are you here to
deliver the Tome of Mors I ordered?

rows.label: qst501804_msg0003
rows.name:
No...actually, I was the
Tome's previous owner.

rows.label: qst501804_msg0004
rows.name:
Oh, really? What, you came to
bring it to me personally?

rows.label: qst501804_msg0005
rows.name: I'm so sorry...

rows.label: qst501804_msg0006
rows.name:
Um... I lost it while it was being
transported from Superbia.

rows.label: qst501804_msg0007
rows.name: What?

rows.label: qst501804_msg0008
rows.name:
More precisely, it wasn't simply
lost. It vanished into the Cloud Sea
with the transport ship.

rows.label: qst501804_msg0009
rows.name: That's awful!

rows.label: qst501804_msg0010
rows.name:
When I got your letter, I gave
the Tome to a courier to send
it quickly to Avaritia...

rows.label: qst501804_msg0011
rows.name:
But the courier ship got attacked by
monsters and sank, or something?

rows.label: qst501804_msg0012
rows.name: Precisely...

rows.label: qst501804_msg0013
rows.name:
You wrote such an enthusiastic letter
and were looking forward to it, so I
came to apologize in person...

rows.label: qst501804_msg0014
rows.name:
Hey, it's not your fault!
It's the monsters or the
courier who are to blame.

rows.label: qst501804_msg0015
rows.name:
Just knowing how you feel is more
than enough to make me happy.

rows.label: qst501804_msg0016
rows.name:
But will this not present a terrible
obstacle to your research...?

rows.label: qst501804_msg0017
rows.name:
Don't worry! I happen to
be acquainted with a very
accomplished salvager.

rows.label: qst501804_msg0018
rows.name:
Do you know whereabouts
it was the ship sank?

rows.label: qst501804_msg0019
rows.name:
I've heard it was around
Umon's Shipyard in Gula.

rows.label: qst501804_msg0020
rows.name:
All right, then. If we know the
location, that ought to be enough!

rows.label: qst501804_msg0021
rows.name: Thank you, Teres-san!

rows.label: qst501804_msg0022
rows.name:
No... I'm just glad there still seems
to be a chance I can help Shiki-san...
